acceptance_criteria: focused unit tests pass for all required regressions
generated runtime compiles and passes focused Ruff and strict mypy
producer validate passes without issuing live authority
repo-wide mypy contains only the accepted historical baseline error
exact changed-path boundary is reviewed before staging
no Kaggle/model/GPU execution occurs in the implementation tranche
problem_statement: The R1 runtime still rejects a symbolic link after venv --copies, and the install subprocess result is not durably written before post-install filesystem inspection. R1 lifecycle authority is also consumed and must not collide with a future issuance.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Would weaken the filesystem integrity boundary far beyond the observed need.
Would mutate the standard venv shape instead of modeling the one known structural exception and could create hidden runtime assumptions.
Would erase a useful fail-closed integrity control.
Already demonstrated to lose the install-process outcome when post-install inspection throws.
R1 is consumed and non-reusable; reuse would violate anti-replay custody.

required_regressions: exact structural lib64 -> lib policy accepts only the governed member/target pair
lib64 with any target other than literal 'lib' is rejected
absolute or escaping symlink target is rejected
TARGET_ROOT/lib being missing or itself a symlink is rejected
SCRATCH_ROOT snapshot accepts only the same exact nested TARGET_ROOT/lib64 member
non-PASSED install process is persisted and post-install snapshot is not attempted
PASSED install process remains durably visible when post-install snapshot fails
cleanup continues to remove scratch and cannot mask a pre-existing primary failure
P5/P6 frozen mechanism function ASTs remain unchanged
historical untracked lifecycle allowlist contains exactly 12 consumed files
fresh R2 lifecycle paths are disjoint from all 12 historical paths
default notebook output resolves to ag-p5-p6-mechanism-tx-lifecycle-r2.ipynb

requirements.contract: directory_snapshot may tolerate only the exact TARGET_ROOT/lib64 symlink when its raw link target is exactly 'lib', TARGET_ROOT/lib exists as a real non-symlink directory, the resolved target equals TARGET_ROOT/lib, and the resolved target remains within TARGET_ROOT. Every other symlink remains fail-closed.
requirements.name: NARROW_STRUCTURAL_SYMLINK_ALLOWANCE

requirements.contract: The exact TARGET_ROOT/lib64 allowance must apply whether directory_snapshot is called on TARGET_ROOT or on SCRATCH_ROOT, so successful runtime cleanup does not report a false secondary failure. The allowance is anchored to the absolute TARGET_ROOT member, not to an arbitrary relative lib64 path.
requirements.name: SNAPSHOT_AND_CLEANUP_USE_SAME_EXACT_POLICY

requirements.contract: Immediately after run_bounded_process returns, persist runtime_install_report_v1.json with the process outcome and immutable install identity fields before any post-install disk or directory snapshot. Check LAUNCH_ERROR/TIMEOUT/NONZERO_EXIT before post-install snapshot. Only a PASSED process may advance to filesystem inspection.
requirements.name: INSTALL_PROCESS_OUTCOME_DURABILITY

requirements.contract: Post-install inspection may enrich the already-persisted install report but may not erase or contradict the process outcome. On snapshot failure, persist snapshot_status=FAILED plus metadata-safe error fields while retaining the process outcome, then fail closed. On snapshot success, persist snapshot_status=PASSED.
requirements.name: MONOTONIC_POST_INSTALL_ENRICHMENT

requirements.contract: Retain the four consumed R1 lifecycle files as historical immutable untracked evidence, expand the historical allowlist from 8 to 12, rotate future live paths to lifecycle_r2, set notebook name to ag-p5-p6-mechanism-tx-lifecycle-r2, set the evidence ZIP name to ag-p5-p6-mechanism-successor-lifecycle-r2-evidence.zip, and require the R2 live namespace to be empty before fresh issuance.
requirements.name: CONSUMED_R1_TO_FRESH_R2_LIFECYCLE

conclusions: The first supported material divergence remains the target-runtime post-install snapshot.
venv --copies alone is insufficient to satisfy the blanket no-symlink invariant.
The exact Kaggle symlink pathname remains unproven.
A narrow structural-symlink policy is justified; a blanket symlink relaxation is not.
Install-process outcome must become durable before any post-install filesystem inspection.
A future authorization requires lifecycle R2 because R1 is consumed.
premises: The executed runtime SHA256 equals the merged R1 runtime identity.
Exactly one runtime-install attempt was consumed.
The primary RuntimeError was 'target runtime contains a symbolic link'.
runtime_install_report_v1.json fell back to NOT_RUN because no durable install report survived.
cleanup preserved the primary failure but its own snapshot still failed.
model loads, worker starts, model requests, P5, and P6 were all zero/not reached.
CPython 3.12 creates lib64 -> lib on 64-bit POSIX non-Darwin venvs independently of executable copy mode.
The R1 authorization is terminal CONSUMED and non-reusable.
trace: offline install process is attempted once
run_bounded_process returns a process result to install_runtime
report construction evaluates post-install snapshots before write_json
runtime_install_report_v1.json is therefore absent at terminal fallback
ensure_install_report writes NOT_RUN because no durable process report exists
main failure reporting preserves the RuntimeError
cleanup_scratch catches its own snapshot RuntimeError and still removes scratch
